'''Aakars''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed at the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was killed.<ref name="Firestar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aakars appears as a named Champion enemy in Outpost Victory during the Heroic misison "Firestar," which can be completed by Imperial players on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Firestar" />
